images.alt: Group photo of several people standing and seated around a meeting table in an indoor office setting. Papers and a laptop are visible on the table. Large windows and framed wall art appear in the background. A dark blue banner across the bottom reads ‘Pacific Expert Advisory Group’. Below the banner are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.

post.text:
The Ministry of Health recently hosted the first meeting of the refreshed Pacific Expert Advisory Group (PEAG) — a key step in strengthening how Pacific voices, evidence and community insight shape our work.

We look forward to working alongside PEAG as they continue this important role.
